_about: Authored illustrations of how a desk might record a resolution, one per Banking77 intent. They are not outcome data and no number in the demo depends on them; they exist so the precedent panel can show a note beside each closed ticket.
activate_my_card: Card activated from the app; no further contact.
age_limit: Explained the minimum age and the junior account option.
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Walked through adding the card to the phone wallet.
atm_support: Listed the ATM networks that accept the card and the fee-free ones.
automatic_top_up: Set up an automatic top-up rule with the customer.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Transfer traced; balance updated the next business day.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposit confirmed as pending; cleared within the stated window.
beneficiary_not_allowed: Beneficiary details corrected and the payee re-added.
cancel_transfer: Transfer cancelled before it left; funds back the same day.
card_about_to_expire: Replacement card ordered automatically; told the delivery window.
card_acceptance: Confirmed where the card is accepted and the known exceptions.
card_arrival: Tracking shared; card arrived within the quoted days.
card_delivery_estimate: Gave the delivery estimate for the region.
card_linking: Linked the new card to the existing account.
card_not_working: Card unblocked after a security check.
card_payment_fee_charged: Fee explained; one-off refund issued as a goodwill gesture.
card_payment_not_recognised: Merchant identified from the descriptor; no dispute needed.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Rate checked against the day's reference; difference refunded.
card_swallowed: Card cancelled and a replacement sent.
cash_withdrawal_charge: Explained the withdrawal allowance and the charge beyond it.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Withdrawal location confirmed with the customer; case closed.
change_pin: Showed how to change the PIN at an ATM.
compromised_card: Card frozen, replaced, and recent transactions reviewed.
contactless_not_working: Contactless enabled after a chip-and-PIN payment.
country_support: Confirmed which countries the account is available in.
declined_card_payment: Decline reason found in the log; limit adjusted.
declined_cash_withdrawal: Daily withdrawal limit explained and raised on request.
declined_transfer: Transfer re-sent after the beneficiary details were fixed.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Originator identified; customer chose to keep the mandate.
disposable_card_limits: Explained the daily number of disposable cards.
exchange_charge: Explained the weekend exchange charge; no refund due.
exchange_rate: Pointed to the live rate shown before each exchange.
exchange_via_app: Walked through exchanging between currency pockets in the app.
extra_charge_on_statement: Charge identified as a merchant pre-authorisation; released.
failed_transfer: Transfer failed on the receiving side; funds returned.
fiat_currency_support: Listed the currencies the account can hold.
get_disposable_virtual_card: Issued a disposable virtual card from the app.
get_physical_card: Physical card ordered; delivery time given.
getting_spare_card: Second card ordered for the same account.
getting_virtual_card: Virtual card created instantly in the app.
lost_or_stolen_card: Card blocked immediately and a replacement ordered.
lost_or_stolen_phone: App session revoked and login reset on a new device.
order_physical_card: Physical card ordered; the fee explained.
pending_card_payment: Explained the pending state; payment settled within the window.
pending_cash_withdrawal: Withdrawal settled the next day; no action needed.
pending_top_up: Top-up arrived once the sending bank released it.
pending_transfer: Transfer completed within the published time.
pin_blocked: PIN unblocked at an ATM after verification.
receiving_money: Shared the account details needed to receive a payment.
Refund_not_showing_up: Refund traced with the merchant; posted within ten days.
request_refund: Refund requested from the merchant on the customer's behalf.
reverted_card_payment?: Explained the reversal; the merchant will re-charge if needed.
supported_cards_and_currencies: Listed the supported card types and currencies.
terminate_account: Account closed and the remaining balance transferred out.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Confirmed bank-transfer top-ups carry no charge.
top_up_by_card_charge: Explained the card top-up fee for that card type.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Explained how cash and cheque deposits are made.
top_up_failed: Top-up failed at the card issuer; retried successfully.
top_up_limits: Explained the top-up limits and how to raise them.
top_up_reverted: Reversal traced to the issuer; funds restored.
topping_up_by_card: Walked through adding a card and topping up.
transaction_charged_twice: Duplicate charge confirmed; refund issued, one touch.
transfer_fee_charged: Fee matched the published schedule; explained.
transfer_into_account: Shared the details for an incoming transfer.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Transfer traced; recipient's bank credited it late.
transfer_timing: Gave the expected timing for that transfer type.
unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verified with an alternative document.
verify_my_identity: Explained the identity check and completed it.
verify_top_up: Top-up verified with a small confirmation charge.
virtual_card_not_working: Virtual card reissued after a merchant block.
visa_or_mastercard: Explained which network the card uses and the choice available.
why_verify_identity: Explained the regulatory reason for identity checks.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM dispute raised; shortfall credited after reconciliation.
